title: Patacones
description: Patacones is a dish from Colombia featuring plantain. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 9 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 8 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
